The narration also directs viewers to an affiliate link, registration of new team members, and a binary structure tied to generating income. It further describes commissions without limit and claims that team strategy can produce more compensation profit. These are concrete recruitment, purchase, and income-promotional features, not merely general information. The supplied material does not establish actual purchases, payouts, the full terms, or whether the displayed claims were fulfilled.
